independent_event_oracle: YAML 1.2.2 specification (§9.2 Streams [211] l-yaml-stream, §10.3.2 Core Schema hex integers) cross-checked against libyaml event stream
cannot_use_independent_json_reason: JSON has no native tag syntax, so the .json golden encodes each local !mach-o tag using ayaml's single-entry wrapper mapping ({"!mach-o": ...}), and libyaml emits untyped scalar strings ("0xFEEDFACF", "1", "2") without Core Schema numeric resolution. Both the two-document event structure (confirming repeated ... markers do not emit a null document) and the resolved integer values (0xFEEDFACF = 4277009103, 1, 2) are independently derived from libyaml and YAML 1.2.2 §9.2 / §10.3.2.
yaml_1_2_2_refs: §9.2 Streams ([211] l-yaml-stream permits repeated document-end suffixes without creating an extra document)
